decisions.reason: The finned tube is a core component of the firm's air cooler business, sits on its own page, and has survived the portfolio cleanup that removed A–D, so dropping it would write off engineering investment tied to the firm's announced direction of continuous product improvement.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes embody the firm's R&D and efficiency promise and remained visibly presented after other launches were pruned, so management is committed to the course of action and would attribute any weak results to temporary market conditions rather than abandon it.
